Summarize fish behaviour in named windows around recorded events

Source: R/event-inference.R
aqt_event_epoch_summary.Rd

This is a descriptive analysis of already tracked/validated data. Event windows are relative to onset and use intervals [start,end); the final epoch includes its right endpoint. Arbitrarily dense frames are NOT independent experimental replicates. For irregular sample intervals choose time_weighted where possible.

Usage

aqt_event_epoch_summary(
  data,
  events,
  outcome,
  windows = list(baseline = c(-120, 0), response = c(0, 120), recovery = c(120, 600)),
  unit_cols = c("camera_id", "track_id"),
  estimator = c("sample_mean", "time_weighted"),
  min_points = 2L,
  max_gap_s = Inf
)

Arguments

data

Table with session_id, time_s, numeric outcome and unit columns.

events

Event table with session_id,event_id,start_s,end_s.

outcome

Name of numeric feature (e.g. speed).

windows

Named list of finite length-two offset vectors, in seconds.

unit_cols

Columns that identify the observational unit within a session, such as tank_id, camera_id, track_id; include treatment only if it is constant within the observational unit.

estimator

sample_mean or trapezoid time_weighted mean.

min_points

Minimum finite observed points for an estimate.

max_gap_s

Largest interval for trapezoid weighting; missing or non-observed observations also break a time-weighted segment.

Value

Descriptive per-session/event/epoch/unit means, counts and time spans.
